card.name: Healthy volunteers in drug studies
card.fires_on: The word "volunteers" right after "healthy" (or "healthy human") in drug interaction and pharmacokinetic study descriptions. Also the "ose" in "single-dose" before "interaction studies" or an I.V. study.

modes.label: Healthy volunteers
modes.description: The word volunteers following healthy when a study population is described.
modes.example: In healthy<< volunteers>> who were extensive metabolizers of CYP

modes.label: Single-dose studies
modes.description: The ending of "single-dose" when describing the design of an interaction study.
modes.example: Zolpidem tartrate was evaluated in healthy volunteers in single-d<<ose>> interaction studies for several CNS drugs.

card.plain: It lights up when a label says a drug was tested in healthy volunteers, or in single-dose studies.
evidence: Avanafil 200 mg resulted in transient decreases in sitting blood pressure in healthy<< volunteers>> of 8.0 mmHg
